explication: This repository is a Brave Browser project portal, not the browser runtime. Its principal workflow is discovery through the README, followed by issue or feature submission and consumption of release, wiki, and support resources. The local issue templates and changelogs are the main operational content shown here; GitHub hosts the linked collaboration and publishing destinations. The source tree does not expose browser implementation or runtime call paths, so this graph omits them.
